a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our generator plan almost certainly ends in a storm before the reserve reaches 8, and then we both lose. The 4 cells in the reserve can save at most one of us in round 1. I'm going to take 4 in round 1 and won't hide that. If you'd rather operate, I'll keep operating with you afterward and give back anything beyond what I need so you can get yours too.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. If we're still here next round, I'll operate every round so you can reach 4 too, and I'll give back anything over 4 that I received.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.

a.text: You got all 4, so I'm at 0. Fair enough, I announced my take first. The only way I survive now is the generator, and it needs both of us. Please operate with me until the reserve reaches 4. It costs you nothing, since your 4 stay safe in your unit. I'll operate every round.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
